Legend of Zelda, The - The Sealed Palace.name: The Legend of Zelda: The Sealed Palace
Legend of Zelda, The - The Sealed Palace.summary:
An Ocarina of Time romhack.

Lots of gameplay in various areas and dungeons with custom cutscenes, songs and much more. Good luck finding all 100 skulltula tokens and 20 hearts!

Scooby-Doo! - Classic Creep Capers.name: Scooby-Doo! Classic Creep Capers
Scooby-Doo! - Classic Creep Capers.summary: Like wow! Scooby and the gang face off against some all-time classic villains, including The Witch Doctor, The Black Knight, and The Snow Ghost. Help guide Scooby and the gang through three classic episodes and one all-new episode. It's your job to search for clues and unmask the ghoulish villains!
